      - name: Install qualified Clang 20 native execution prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key
          fingerprint=$(gpg --show-keys --with-colons "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" | awk -F: '$1 == "fpr" { print $10; exit }')
          test "$fingerprint" = 6084F3CF814B57C1CF12EFD515CF4D18AF4F7421
          sudo install -m 0644 "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-llvm.asc" /usr/share/keyrings/hia-llvm.asc
          printf '%s\n' 'deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/hia-llvm.asc] https://apt.llvm.org/noble/ llvm-toolchain-noble-20 main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/hia-llvm20.list
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y binutils gcc clang-20 libclang-rt-20-dev strace
          printf 'CLANG=/usr/bin/clang-20\nHEPTA_CLANG=/usr/bin/clang-20\n' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: python -m pip install setuptools==78.1.1 wheel==0.46.3 z3-solver==4.15.4.0 jsonschema==4.26.0
      - name: Prepare original locked Rust caller dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo --version
          rustc --version
          sha256sum rust/hia-core-shadow/Cargo.toml rust/hia-core-shadow/Cargo.lock > "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-rust-caller-inputs.sha256"
          cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path rust/hia-core-shadow/Cargo.toml
          sha256sum --check "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-rust-caller-inputs.sha256"
          git diff --exit-code -- rust/hia-core-shadow/Cargo.toml rust/hia-core-shadow/Cargo.lock
      - run: python -B tools/replay_hia_selfhost_cold.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-cold.json"
      - name: Original call graph and native convergence controls
        run: python -B tools/run_hia_unittest_gate.py tests.test_hia_selfhost_call_graph_efficiency.CallGraphNativeTests
      - run: python -B tests/test_hia_selfhost_language_coverage.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-language.json"
      - name: Prepare isolated continuation-family evidence
        run: mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-continuation-family"
      - name: Native linked loader and compiler receipt bindings
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYBINDINGS'
          from hashlib import sha256
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import unittest
          from tools.build_hia_json_preflight import admit_cold_build
          cold_path = Path(os.environ['HEPTA_HIA_LINKED_OBSERVER_COLD_REPORT'])
          cold_bytes = cold_path.read_bytes()
          cold = json.loads(cold_bytes)
          nested_bytes = Path(cold['nested_report']).read_bytes()
          if sha256(nested_bytes).hexdigest() != cold['nested_report_sha256']:
              raise ValueError('current cold nested report changed before receipt controls')
          nested = json.loads(nested_bytes)
          compiler = Path(nested['generations'][-1]['produced_image'])
          compiler_bytes = compiler.read_bytes()
          admit_cold_build(compiler_bytes, cold_bytes)
          os.environ['HEPTA_HIA_COMPILE_RECEIPT_COMPILER'] = str(compiler)
          os.environ['HEPTA_HIA_COMPILE_RECEIPT_COMPILER_SHA256'] = sha256(compiler_bytes).hexdigest()
          names = (
              'tests.test_hia_selfhost_linked_observer.LinkedObserverNativeTests',
              'tests.test_hia_original_select_fragments.CompleteOutputObservationTests',
              'tests.test_hia_compile_receipt_binding.CompileReceiptNativeTests',
          )
          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(names)
          if suite.countTestCases() != 37:
              raise AssertionError('complete linked-loader and receipt control inventory changed')
          _loaded_count = suite.countTestCases()
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
          unchanged = (compiler.read_bytes() == compiler_bytes
                       and cold_path.read_bytes() == cold_bytes
                       and Path(cold['nested_report']).read_bytes() == nested_bytes)
          passed = (result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun == 37 and unchanged
                    and not result.skipped and not result.expectedFailures
                    and not result.unexpectedSuccesses)
          complete = result.testsRun == _loaded_count and _loaded_count > 0
          clean = not (result.errors or result.failures or result.skipped or
                       result.expectedFailures or result.unexpectedSuccesses)
          raise SystemExit(0 if (passed) and complete and clean else 1)
          PYBINDINGS

def step(name):
    source = WORKFLOW.read_text().splitlines()
    start, = (i for i, line in enumerate(source) if line == '      - name: ' + name)
    end = next((i for i in range(start + 1, len(source)) if source[i].startswith('      - ')), len(source))
